PDF Efficiently Rendering Large Volume Data Using Texture Mapping Hardware
Abstract. Volume rendering with texture mapping hardware is a fast volume rendering method available on high-end workstations. However, limited texture memory often prevents the method from being used to render large volume data efficiently. In this paper, we propose a new approach to fast rendering of large volume data with texture mapping ...
